1.note: As printed (Matthew 23, 22); the Sadducees' denial of the resurrection is Matthew 22:23. Kept as printed.

2.note: The print is unclear between ס"ה and ס"ח; read ס"ה (Menaḥot 65a, the Boethusian dispute on the omer).

3.note: As printed; the mishnah on the greater stringency of the words of the Scribes is Sanhedrin 11:3. Kept as printed.

4.he: אשר נאנחו מן הממשלה על ההיפוך
4.note: Literally "who groaned from the government over the reversal"; read as the oppression and upheaval under Antiochus.

5.note: As printed (book 1, 44); the decision to fight on the Sabbath is 1 Maccabees 2:41. Kept as printed.

6.he: וכן מקרה כל מתנגד מאז אם התנגדותו היא לשום סבה אחרת
6.note: The sentence is elliptic; read as: every opponent is the one who leaves the old path, even when his opposition has another cause.
